text:
maya: Heads-up: customer reported unexpected quota spikes when using client-side route affinity in TS SDK + retries. Happens only when stream is retried after an early 5xx.

raj: repro steps?

maya: quick: 1) make streaming request with `routeHint: 'aff-1'` 2) server returns transient 502 mid-stream 3) SDK retries from client, re-sends same estimate header -> tenant sees two "requested" entries, console shows double-estimate but only one charged after patch, so app-layer metrics and console disagree.

emily: from platform side: we emit `X-Quota-Estimate` on request start but recently also added `X-Route-Affinity` enforcement for sticky placement. If the client retries without clearing local pre-decrement, it can pre-consume tokens twice.

lee: TS SDK behavior: we pre-decrement local quota bucket when we see `X-Quota-Estimate` + `preferPreDebit=true` in config. That was intentional to prevent thundering retries. But we never revoke the decrement if server says "duplicate" on subsequent attempts.

david: can server include a `Retry-Id` or `Request-Id` to indicate idempotency? We could avoid double local decrement if retry reuses same id.

emily: we have `X-Request-Id` but SDKs generate their own for retry. platform can echo back `X-Request-Id` in the body/header. Might help.

nicole: console: customers see two lines in route-level "estimated" and only one in tenant "charged" for same timeslice. PM wants clearer labels and a reconciler.

sarah: UX suggestion: add a small legend and a tooltip: "Estimated = client-side pre-debit; Charged = server accounting (authoritative)." Also add a migration flag for customers to opt-in to server-side pre-checks view.

raj: proposal: change TS SDK to not pre-decrement unless `config.safePreDebit = true` AND server returns header `X-Quota-Preallowed: yes`. That way platform opt-in avoids heuristics.

lee: agree. TLDR patch: 
```ts
// before sending:
if (serverAllowsPredebit && config.safePreDebit) localBucket.debit(estimate)
// on retry: if same requestId -> don't debit again
```
I'll open PR.

maya: platform-side quick mitigations?

emily: two small things we can ship today: 1) platform will echo `X-Request-Id` and return `X-Quota-Preallowed: yes|no` when it has pre-validation for the route; 2) console will annotate the period with "client pre-debits visible".

david: do we need telemetry? I want to know which client versions pre-debit and how often retries cause double-debits.

emily: adding `quota.client_predebit=true/false` to request logs. Also emit `quota.retry.duplicate_detected` if a request with same `X-Request-Id` comes in.

nicole: will add a console widget that shows "pre-debit vs charged" delta for last 24h. PM would love a CSV export.

lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/ts-sdk/pull/402 (draft). Patch adds `config.safePreDebit` default false, honor `X-Quota-Preallowed`, and dedupe on `X-Request-Id`.

raj: good. let's coordinate release: can we ship platform echo + header today, and SDK next-day?

emily: platform will flip echo in canary now. I'll post canary id and rollout window.

maya: docs: update the SDK guide explaining `safePreDebit` and `X-Quota-Preallowed`. Also add a snippet for servers to echo `X-Request-Id`.

david: integration tests: I'll add a scenario to sdk-integration-suite that simulates a mid-stream 502 and asserts that the tenant's charged tokens equal one final charge and console delta <= 1 pre-debit.

integration-bot: canary deploy started (job 9013) - platform echo headers enabled for us-west-2.

sarah: PM update sent. PM asked for a short blurb for support playbook: "If you see discrepancy between estimated and charged, ask for client SDK version and whether safePreDebit is enabled."

maya: ok wrapping up: lee -> land PR; david -> add tests; emily -> canary echo header; nicole -> console delta widget; sarah -> support blurb. Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

lee: will tag @maya in PR when ready.
